key_insight: A general-purpose language model can directly write the weights of a small neural network to rank materials without property labels and improve early-stage discovery.
engineering_relevance: These label-free networks can initialize surrogate models and screen generated crystals when measurements are scarce.
method: Provide a task description, input names, and a zero-initialized network with 16 hidden units.
Have the language model fill in every network weight directly as text.
Use the network for ranking, as a Bayesian model's prior mean, or as a crystal-generator screen.
evidence_signal: At five labels, network-informed Gaussian processes improved Spearman ranking correlation from 0.35 to 0.69 on alloys and from 0.15 to 0.95 on crystals; Bayesian optimization regret fell significantly on 4 of 5 experimental tasks.
watch_item: Benefits are confined to the first tens of labels and targets not already well ranked by simple rules or subsystem extrapolation.
